verses.text: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron's two sons, who died when they came near the LORD.

The LORD said to Moses, "Tell your brother Aaron not to come whenever he likes into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain, in front of the cover on the Covenant Box, or he will die. For I appear in the cloud above the cover.
This is how Aaron must come into the holy place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

He must put on the holy linen shirt, with linen underwear on his body. He must tie the linen belt around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy clothes. He must bathe his body in water and then put them on.
From the community of Israel he must take two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
Aaron will offer the bull as a sin offering for himself, to make himself and his family right with God.
Then he will take the two goats and present them to the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
He will cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD and the other for the goat that is sent away.
Aaron will bring forward the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and offer it as a sin offering.
But the goat chosen by lot to be sent away will be presented alive before the LORD. It will be used to make people right with God by sending it into the desert as the goat that carries away sin.
Aaron will bring the bull for his own sin offering, to make himself and his family right with God, and he will kill the bull for his sin offering.
He will take a pan full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of finely ground sweet incense, and bring them behind the curtain.
He will put the incense on the fire before the LORD, so that the cloud of incense covers the cover that is above the Covenant Box. Then he will not die.

He will take some of the bull's blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the cover, on the east side. He will also sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times in front of the cover.

Then he will kill the goat for the people's sin offering and bring its blood behind the curtain. He will do with the goat's blood as he did with the bull's blood: sprinkle it on the cover and in front of the cover.

In this way he will make the Most Holy Place right with God, because of the uncleanness of the people of Israel and because of their wrongs, all their sins. He will do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which stands among them in the middle of their uncleanness.

No one else may be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make the Most Holy Place right with God until he comes out. He must make himself, his family, and the whole community of Israel right with God.
Then he will go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make it right with God. He will take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.
He will sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, to clean it and make it holy from the uncleanness of the people of Israel.
When he has finished making the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar right with God, he will bring forward the live goat.

Aaron will put both his hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wrongs of the people of Israel, all their sins and ways of going wrong. He will put them on the goat's head, and then send the goat away into the desert with a man who is ready to take it.
The goat will carry all their wrongs on itself to a lonely place, and the man will let the goat go in the desert.
Then Aaron will go into the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen clothes he wore when he went into the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.

He will bathe his body in water in a holy place, put on his regular clothes, and come out. Then he will offer his burnt offering and the people's burnt offering, to make himself and the people right with God.
He will burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
The man who takes the goat away into the desert must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. After that he may come back into the camp.

The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make people right with God, must be taken outside the camp. Their skins, their meat, and their dung must be burned in the fire.
The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. After that he may come back into the camp.
This is a rule for you forever: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you must go without food and do no work at all, whether you were born in the land or are a foreigner living among you.
For on this day you will be made right with God and cleaned. You will be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
It is a day of complete rest for you, and you must go without food. This is a rule forever.
The priest who is anointed and set apart to take his father's place will make people right with God. He will put on the linen clothes, the holy clothes.
He will make the Most Holy Place right with God, and the Tent of Meeting and the altar. He will make the priests and all the people of the community right with God.
This is a rule forever for you: once a year make the people of Israel right with God for all their sins." And it was done as the LORD commanded Moses.
